You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a fridge. You can make out a closed oven right there by you. You can see a table. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of junk. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table. You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a counter. You see a raw red potato on the counter. Huh, weird. You can make out a stove. The stove is conventional. But there isn't a thing on it.



There is a red apple and a banana on the floor.
